images.caption:
This is a small part of the departures area of the large Terminal 5a at London's Heathrow Airport.

Along with the smaller Terminals 5b and 5c it is used 99% by British Airways, together with occasional Iberia flights (who are part of the same group).

images.caption: London Heathrow Airport in 1965. Nearest the camera are two BOAC aircraft – a  Vickers VC10 (with the high tail) and a Boeing 707. Then two PanAm 707s. (Between them I think there’s an Air India 707) The aircraft vaguely seen in the distance, on the far right, is a BEA Argosy (with twin booms).  On the left in the background are two Air Canada DC-8's.
